rules: DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for headings.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) for sizes > 32px.
Line height must be leading-none for headers.
Line height must be leading-relaxed for better legibility of data grids.
Overlines and labels MUST be uppercase, text-xs, with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

brand_accents.description: Electric Blaze for kinetic triggers, progress bars, and main CTAs.

rules: Avoid vibrating lime. Use Electric Blaze (#FF3B30) as the kinetic trigger.
NEVER use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for this dashboard.
Text visibility must meet APCA contrast standards.
Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for KPI metrics.
Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6).
Summary widgets span col-span-1.
Primary charts span col-span-2 or col-span-3.
Every pixel utilized; use h-full on children to match neighbor heights.

shell.sidebar: Fixed width (e.g., w-64), hidden on mobile, distinct active states.
shell.header: Sticky header with backdrop-blur and 1px bottom border. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds.
shell.mobile_nav: Hamburger menu on mobile only. Desktop MUST show all links.

spacing: Generous spacing for layout padding (p-6 or p-8 inside main content).
Tight padding inside data-dense cards (p-4 or p-6).

cards.style: Tactical Minimalism. Flat backgrounds, max 4px border-radius (rounded-sm) or sharp edges.
cards.borders: 1px solid strokes (border-border). Replace soft shadows with 1px solid borders or 2px inner glow highlights.
cards.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and border color darkens/lightens.

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm), high contrast. Only use primary color for main CTAs.

badges.style: Uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs, solid 1px border matching the text color.

tables_and_lists.style: Use Shadcn table components in .jsx or .js format. Zebra striping or subtle hover states. Left align dense data.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' pattern for data-heavy sections (border-collapse, border-r, border-b).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or floating overlays, use bg-white/70 or bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px delicate inner stroke. NEVER just transparent.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboard layouts.

rules: Minimalist animations.
Micro-interactions for feedback (hover states, click/press).
Staggered entrance for lists.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
DO NOT use universal transition 'all'. Transition specific properties like transform and opacity.
Contrast: Normal text > 4.5:1, large text > 3:1.
Hover: Always explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-900 hover:text-white).
Focus: Must have higher contrast than default state (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

login_background.description: Shirtless man lifting barbell in gym. Good for high-intensity authentication background.

gym_cover_placeholder.description: Gym filled with lots of machines. Good for gym setting default cover.

avatar_placeholder.description: Man in a black tank top posing. Avatar for members or trainers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize using Shadcn/UI primitives for tables, dialogs, cards, dropdowns (adapted for .js/.jsx), but override their border-radius and shadows to match the 'Tactical Minimalism' style (sharp edges, 1px borders, no soft shadows).
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard icons.
Implement light and dark mode toggling seamlessly.
All KPI cards should be strictly grid aligned, utilizing h-full to avoid jagged bottoms.
Do not add universal centered layouts (.App { text-align: center }). Maintain left-alignment for dashboards.
Apply data-testid to every clickable element (buttons, links, table rows, dropdown items).
Empty states should use the 'Avatar/Icon' + 'Title' + 'Description' + 'Action Button' structure. Keep them centered within their container.
Implement status badges according to the 'status' colors defined in this schema.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs like slop gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs/headers.
MUST NOT apply universal transition: all. Target specific properties.
Always use modern button styles (sharp edges for this app).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active states).
Remember to apply guidelines for .js files not for .tsx files.
